title: High cyclomatic complexity: get_config (CCN=19)
detail: `get_config` has a cyclomatic complexity of 19 over 65 lines (L39–133). Functions this complex are hard to test exhaustively, tend to accumulate subtle conditional bugs, and resist refactoring. Suggested fix: extract cohesive sub-operations into smaller, named functions with clear preconditions.

title: Unnecessary `pass` in abstract/stub methods (2 instances)
detail: Abstract method stubs or pure interface declarations contain a bare `pass` statement alongside a docstring or `raise NotImplementedError`. The `pass` is redundant when a docstring or `raise` already makes the function body non-empty. Suggested fix: remove the redundant `pass` statements.
